entities.name: Heinz Roch
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Heinz Roch was a German Nazi Party politician, SS-Oberführer and SS and Police Leader (SSPF) in the Crimea, the Bialystok District and northern Norway during the Second World War. He committed suicide at the end of the war.
